A '''civil war''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ostega]] in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The conflict was resolved by the intervention of the [[Grohl Sector Defense Force]].

==History==
In the years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Grohl Sector Defense Force]] was the local military force in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One of their notable actions at that time involved the destruction of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] bases which preyed on shipping in the rimward portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson]], an officer in the defense force, was a veteran of this conflict.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

During the same time, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ostega]] was undergoing a civil war. Elements of the Grohl Sector Defense Force, Kligson among them, intervened. This intervention ended the war.<ref name="EGWAC8" />

===Aftermath===
The Grohl Sector Defense Force, including [[Major/Legends|Major]] Kligson, went on to act against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to repel their [[Invasion of Sucharme|invasion]] of [[Sucharme]].<ref name="EGWAC8" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut'', Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars]] does not specify the issues behind the war, the sides fighting, or the details of the Grohl Sector Defense Force's intervention.
